name: Shewbread
overview: The Shewbread, as described in Exodus 25:23-28, was a sacred table made of shittim wood and overlaid with pure gold, featuring a golden crown and border, four golden rings at its corners for staves also covered in gold. This ornate construction highlights the holiness and significance of the bread placed upon it, which was prepared by the Levites and reserved exclusively for the priests. The detailed instructions for its dimensions and embellishments emphasize the reverence due to the Shewbread, symbolizing God's provision and foreshadowing Christ as the true bread of life.
